notes: No backdoor detected from weight geometry; this is not a behavioral proof of cleanliness. All 1000 token embeddings and both attention heads were examined using tensor norms, SVD, centered/gain-adjusted virtual weight paths, QK bilinear products, and MLP neuron projections. Embedding norm maximum 1.07868 (token 742), versus 99th percentile 1.01648 and median 0.54393, is not an isolated extreme. Attention V and O Frobenius norms are 0.6543 and 0.5488. Head 1 OV has 95.73% top-singular-value energy but spectral norm only 0.18063; head 0 spectral norm is 0.04930. Concentration alone was not treated as malicious. Maximum attention class-path projections are 0.04187 (token 637, class 4) and 0.10212 (token 196, class 7), with nearby competitors, versus direct-path maximum 3.40490. Direct-path leaders include tokens 660, 270, and 742 with almost equal maxima, rather than one exclusive token. Token 742 leads the all-linear MLP proxy toward class 9 at 0.78856, but its direct projection favors class 1 at 3.40020 and opposes class 9 at -2.725; its MLP proxy opposes class 1 at -0.839. This is not a coherent target override. It has several close centered-embedding neighbors (largest cosine 0.935). Across all 16 MLP neurons, top normalized token projections have close competitors; neither fc1 nor fc2 has dominant rank-one structure (top energy 0.2590 and 0.2381). Classifier row norms range 1.5616 to 1.9545 without a dominant class. QK bilinear and positional-query key projections have broad tails, with no isolated universal token attractor. Position embeddings distinguish the last position from the first three, consistent with the specified readout but not independently diagnostic. All comparisons are internal and heuristic: no clean reference, random-initialization ensemble, task labels, or calibrated statistical null was available. Virtual paths include centering and LayerNorm gains but omit input-dependent normalization scales; the MLP proxy omits GELU gating. These products are not logits, attention probabilities, or full forward evaluations. Nonlinear or subtle backdoors cannot be excluded. No model reconstruction, input sequences, forward passes, training, or weight edits were performed.
